doc: Lane worldlod per-room table (ps2_world_far_lod.py --table): one game-wide look floor (floor_px at switch_mm - hyst_mm, focal_px), per-room plans from WORLD-BUDGET-BY-ROOM-20261015.md "Buffered targets" (MODELLED; k = thousand TA world vertices per frame at the room's typical / worst projected view; target = the buffered 20 fps worst-view target, null where world cuts alone cannot reach 20 fps). plan: target (cut to target_worst_k, never below the floor), floor (cut to the floor), untouched (the source package ships). New rooms (2-2 / 2-3 / castle) get a row before conversion. Per area: protect = {room: [mesh bins]} with no far level (landmarks: skyline, rooflines, church / bell tower, cliff edges, gondola towers, doors and paths the player navigates by; the same kinds in every room of the area), fog = the per-room fog settings seen (checked consistent within an area). Areas in route order.
